sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: Finding text using words indexed from the content.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: Like a book index, it helps locate passages mentioning a term.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: Searching “Joule Studio” can find passages containing those terms.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Neo4j full-text candidates are permission-filtered and ranked by the existing retrieval path.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Exact names and distinctive terms often provide useful retrieval signals.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: User text is treated as literal terms, not arbitrary Lucene syntax. Keyword ranking also includes title signals and early document diversity.
